features.name: ai_use_type_position_score
features.description: Min-max normalization of the observed AI-use code from -1 to 9 into a bounded 0 to 1 score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Preserves broad use-type variation in a scale-compatible feature for linear SVM margins.

features.name: ai_method_specificity_score
features.description: Weighted 0 to 1 intensity of explicit AI, algorithm, machine-learning, and deep-learning terminology; tri-state mention fields are mapped from -1/0/1 into 0/0.5/1 before averaging.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth technology-depth axis rather than several sparse mention flags.

features.name: digital_delivery_intensity_score
features.description: Weighted 0 to 1 signal for deployable digital delivery through software, mobile app, wearable, and real-world deployment fields.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses correlated delivery cues into one continuous product-readiness axis for a linear separator.

features.name: evidence_design_rigor_score
features.description: Weighted 0 to 1 study-rigor composite from evidence strength, randomization, blinding, phase bucket, and enrollment bucket.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a smooth evidence-quality axis that is easier for a linear SVM than separate sparse design flags.

features.name: trial_scale_reach_score
features.description: 0 to 1 measure of operational scale combining later phase, larger enrollment bucket, and logarithmic country reach.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates an approximately linear projection of trial maturity and geographic reach.

features.name: current_activity_score
features.description: 0 to 1 operational activity score emphasizing recruiting status, not-yet-completed status, deployment readiness, and enrollment size.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates active-development profiles from finished or unclear profiles via a smooth one-dimensional score.

features.name: governance_safety_attention_score
features.description: 0 to 1 intensity of bias, safety, and privacy attention in the trial record.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a continuous governance axis that may align with regulated AI development without relying on sparse text flags.

features.name: population_inclusion_breadth_score
features.description: 0 to 1 breadth measure combining all-sex eligibility, child inclusion, older-adult inclusion, enrollment size, and country reach.
features.expected_model_benefit: Summarizes participant-coverage breadth into a single smooth margin feature.

features.name: internationalization_score
features.description: 0 to 1 geographic expansion score combining the international-trial flag and log-scaled country count.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures global operational reach with reduced sensitivity to outlier country counts.

features.name: deployment_evidence_ratio_score
features.description: Clipped deployment-to-evidence ratio comparing real-world deployment intensity with normalized evidence strength; the small constant stabilizes low-evidence rows.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights deployment-heavy records relative to documented evidence as a continuous nonlinear contrast for SVM margins.

features.name: workflow_integration_judgment
features.description: Human or semantic-model score from 0.0 to 1.0 for how directly the AI tool appears integrated into clinical workflow: 0.0 means retrospective or analytic context, 1.0 means direct prospective use in care delivery. Use only row fields such as ai_use_type, real_world_deployment_score, software/mobile/wearable mentions, trial status, and evidence score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-formulaic context about operational embedding that may be nonlinear across coded fields.

features.name: market_pathway_judgment
features.description: Human or semantic-model score from 0.0 to 1.0 for how clearly the study resembles a scalable deployable product pathway: 0.0 means exploratory method work, 1.0 means mature solution with clear distribution or device/software pathway. Use only non-sponsor row fields such as ai_use_type, disease_area, trial_phase_bucket, deployment score, enrollment_bucket, country_count, and digital-modality mentions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds expert semantic compression of product-pathway cues that a linear SVM may not easily infer from individual encoded fields.
